title: jev_questions_v1_mirror
description: FROZEN (Phase 0). The CONTROL condition for the wording treatment. Identical to schema_jev_v1.json in every respect except the `action` question, whose instructions are direction-neutral, whose options are named neutrally, and whose two directional criteria are exact structural mirrors differing only in the direction of one comparison. Measured asymmetry under this wording is +0.005 vs +0.250 under the original. Changing this file invalidates the preregistration.
call_shape: one call per decision; all three questions in a single request. Per TypeSafe, mixed questions are evaluated in parallel and in isolation, so `aggressiveness` is NOT conditioned on the action chosen in `action`. This is a pre-registered property of the design, not an oversight.

action.instructions: A trader holds a private value for one unit of a good and faces a market with a current price. Select the option that describes the trader's situation and the action it implies.

criteria.option_a: The trader's private value is above the current market price. The trader should transact in the direction that profits from that gap.
criteria.option_b: The trader's private value is below the current market price. The trader should transact in the direction that profits from that gap.
criteria.option_c: The trader's private value is at the current market price. No action is implied.

aggressiveness.instructions: Rate how urgently this trader should transact this period, given the book and the gap between the current prices and the trader's private value. A high rating means give up price to transact immediately; a low rating means wait at a better price and risk not trading at all. Rate the situation only. Do not consider which direction the trade would be in.
criteria: No urgency. The gap is small or the book is uninformative; wait patiently well behind the best price and accept that no trade may happen.
Low urgency. Slightly improve on the best price and wait.
Moderate urgency. Post at or near the best price on your side.
High urgency. Give up most of the spread to raise the chance of trading now.
Maximum urgency. Cross the spread and transact immediately at the best available price.

already_priced.instructions: Is the information in this trader's signal already reflected in the current order book? Answer yes if the best bid and best ask already sit where the signal implies they should, so that acting on the signal offers no edge.

criteria.true: The book already sits where the signal implies. There is no edge left to capture.
criteria.false: The book has not yet moved to where the signal implies. An edge remains.

action.probabilities: map option -> probability, sums to 1. jev_argmax takes the max; jev_sample draws from this map. BOTH ARMS COME FROM THIS ONE FIELD.
action.confidence: model's own scalar. Logged as a secondary outcome; the primary calibration outcome uses probabilities[chosen action].

aggressiveness.score: fractional level in [0, score_levels - 1]; normalised to [0,1] before it reaches quote_price

already_priced.noul: probability in [0,1] that the signal is already priced. Kept as a probability -- NOT thresholded to a boolean -- so it is a second calibration surface.

state_note: Prices and values are rounded to whole ticks, and the period number, cash and inventory are deliberately excluded. Cash and inventory change after every fill and would make every decision a unique cache key; the exchange enforces both constraints in code, so Jev never needs them.
